name: Contiguous Azerbaijan

population.source: 2019 census of Azerbaijan, as the national total less Nakhchivan's
population.note: Derived by subtraction within the 2019 census: 9,951,409 (the Total row of Demographics of Azerbaijan) less 458,910 (Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic's infobox). The census did not enumerate the area then held by the self-declared Republic of Artsakh -- it counted 178 Armenians in the whole country -- so that area's Armenian population is not in this figure.
